name: Agros
description: A sunlit, gently rolling field at the woodland edge where children and animals tend rows, play, and speak Greek.

color_palette: Warm wheat gold (#E2C044) for grasses, grain heads, and hay bales.
Soft meadow green (#7FB77E) for clover, rows of crops, and leafy borders.
Clear sky blue (#8EC9F2) for open skies and water trough highlights.
Earthy brown (#8B5E3C) for soil paths, wooden fences, and tools.
Poppy red (#E84A5F) as small accents on flowers, baskets, and toy details.
visual_style.architectural_style: Rustic agrarian with low split-rail fences, a small fieldstone well, and a simple lean-to shed. Compositions keep forms rounded and uncluttered, framed from a child-height viewpoint.
visual_style.flora_fauna: Rows of wheat and vegetables mingle with clover and wildflowers; bees and butterflies drift over the furrows. Sparrows, field mice, and gentle farm friends like sheep and a small goat wander near the fence.
materials: Weathered wood fences and gate slats
Fieldstone well and low boundary walls
Clay water jar and simple rope pulley
